setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=/N[ãa]o foi poss[ií]vel|Erro ao|Tente novamente|indispon[ií]vel|Algo deu errado|Falha ao|Transi[çc][ãa]o inv[áa]lida|n[ãa]o encontrad|Localiza[çc][ãa]o n[ãa]o registrada|Sem sinal de GPS/i;const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);setInterval(()=>{const f=document.querySelector('section[aria-label^="Lembrete da trilha"]');if(f&&window.__avisos.length<10&&!window.__avisos.includes('TRILHA ECOFLIX'))window.__avisos.push('TRILHA ECOFLIX')},300);return 1})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const pares=[["Total de coletas", "4"], ["Concluídas", "1"], ["Canceladas", "0"], ["Taxa de conclusão", "25%"]];let out='';for(let i=0;i<22;i++){const falta=[];for(const [rot,val] of pares){const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('main *')].find(e=>e.children.length===0&&e.textContent.trim()===rot);if(!el){falta.push(rot+'=?');continue;}let c=el.parentElement,ok=false;for(let k=0;k<4&&c;k++,c=c.parentElement){const ls=c.innerText.split('\n').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);if(ls.length>1){ok=ls.includes(val);if(!ok)falta.push(rot+'='+ls.filter(x=>x!==rot).slice(0,2).join('/'));break;}}}if(!falta.length)return 'OK: '+pares.map(p=>p.join(' ')).join(' | ');out='DIFERENTE: '+falta.join(' | ');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return out})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const rolagem=(el)=>{let c=el&&el.parentElement;while(c&&c!==document.body){const s=getComputedStyle(c);if(/(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&c.scrollHeight>c.clientHeight+4)return c;c=c.parentElement;}const se=document.scrollingElement;return se&&se.scrollHeight>se.clientHeight+4?se:null};const el=[...document.querySelectorAll("main *")].find(e=>e.children.length===0&&e.textContent.trim()==="Por status");if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';const c=rolagem(el);if(!c)return 'SEM ROLAGEM';const dy=Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top-130);if(Math.abs(dy)<3)return 'ok';const y0=c.scrollTop,t0=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/900),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;c.scrollTo({top:y0+dy*e,behavior:'instant'});p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top)})()
